threads.body: [General] This v3-preview gate conflicts with the configuration stability policy: names containing `experimental` are unstable and must remain ungated when deprecated; preview gating is reserved for deprecated stable names that must survive until 3.0 (`.github/agents/knowledge/config-property-stability.md:110-115,264-270`). Continue applying and warning for this alias regardless of v3-preview, and remove the corresponding preview-specific behavior from tests and documentation.

threads.body: [General] This reintroduces preview gating for an unstable configuration name. Because `otel.instrumentation.common.messaging.experimental.headers.*` contains `experimental`, the deprecated alias must remain applied (with its warning) under v3-preview; preview gating is reserved for deprecated stable names. As written, enabling v3-preview silently falls through to the older alias or disables configured header capture. Remove this gate and update the preview-specific tests and documentation accordingly.
